title: Performance uncertainty in medical image analysis: A large-scale investigation of confidence intervals
mechanism: Large-scale CI coverage study: required sample size, metric, macro vs micro aggregation and CI method all change coverage; decision tree for CI choice.
adaptation: Pick CI method and aggregation (pooled vs per-cell) per metric with their decision tree; flag inactive on test (16 cells) as below reliable coverage.
min_experiment: Arm: pooled vs per-cell aggregation on OOF house vs PF. Metric: paired-delta t. Kill: keep the higher-t aggregation; if within 10% keep pooled.
evidence: R: 24 segmentation and classification tasks, 19 models per task group; sample size for reliable CIs ranges from dozens to thousands; macro needs more cases than micro.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack IoU here is pooled over pixels (micro), and inactive is decided by 3 cells. Report both pooled and per-cell (macro) scores with the CI method the decision tree picks, and fix the aggregation in the protocol.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Compute micro and macro crack/inactive IoU and their CIs for the house seeds. Keep the aggregation with fewer seed-to-seed rank flips between house and PF.
